title: a foreign constructor is not lowerable unless its resolved constructor declares @throws {never}
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Foreign Exceptions': 'Calling any TypeScript, JavaScript, or other foreign runtime implementation MUST add the distinguished checked panic case by default ... A caller MUST propagate panic, explicitly catch it, or use a trusted adapter.' `new Counter(41)` is such a call, and poc/src/language/README.md records that constructor Result lowering is deferred, so the only accepted foreign constructor is one with a checker-resolved @throws {never}. Fail-closed: the alternative would be a foreign constructor whose throw escapes every checked channel.
